fullPassage: One of the most powerful tools to find meaning in our lives is reflective journaling — thinking back on and writing about what has happened to us. In the 1990s, Stanford University researchers asked undergraduate students on spring break to journal about their most important personal values and their daily activities; others were asked to write about only the good things that happened to them in the day. Three weeks later, the students who had written about their values were happier, healthier, and more confident about their ability to handle stress than the ones who had only focused on the good stuff. By reflecting on how their daily activities supported their values, students had gained a new perspective on those activities and choices. Little stresses and hassles were now demonstrations of their values in action. Suddenly, their lives were full of meaningful activities. And all they had to do was reflect and write about it — positively reframing their experiences with their personal values.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ① are → is: 주어의 핵은 One(단수)이므로 단수 동사
det.analysis:

✅ ② handle: 'ability to handle'의 to부정사로 적절
✅ ③ gained: 'had gained'의 과거완료로 적절

det.tip: One of the + 복수명사 + 단수동사! 진짜 주어는 One이라 is (are는 함정)

det.korean: sicker(더 아픈)는 healthier(더 건강한)와 반대

✅ ① powerful: 의미를 찾는 강력한 도구. 원문 적절

✅ ③ perspective: 새로운 관점을 얻었다. 원문 적절
✅ ④ meaningful: 의미 있는 활동으로 가득. 원문 적절
det.tip: happier, __, more confident는 모두 긍정! 그 사이엔 healthier(더 건강한)가 맞아요

det.korean: lost(잃었다)는 gained(얻었다)의 반대
det.analysis:
✅ ① important: 가장 중요한 개인적 가치. 원문 적절
✅ ② supported: 일상 활동이 가치를 뒷받침했다. 원문 적절

ch: 실험 참가자 중 일부는 하루의 좋은 일들에 대해서만 기록했다

questions.passage: One of the most powerful tools to find meaning in our lives is reflective journaling — thinking back on and writing about what has happened to us. In the 1990s, Stanford University researchers asked undergraduate students on spring break to journal about their most important personal values and their daily activities; others were asked to write about only the good things that happened to them in the day. Three weeks later, the students who had ①<u>written</u> about their values were happier, healthier, and more confident about their ability to ②<u>handle</u> stress than the ones who had only focused on the good stuff. By reflecting on how their daily activities supported their values, students had ③<u>gained</u> a new perspective on those activities and choices. Little stresses and hassles were now demonstrations of their values in action. Suddenly, their lives were full of meaningful activities. And all they had to do was ④<u>reflecting</u> and write about it — positively reframing their experiences with their personal values.
questions.stem: 다음 글에서 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ④ reflecting → reflect: 'all ... to do was' 뒤에는 원형부정사
det.analysis:
✅ ① written: 'the students who had written'의 과거완료로 적절
✅ ② handle: 'their ability to handle stress'의 to부정사로 적절
✅ ③ gained: 'students had gained'의 과거완료로 적절
❌ ④ reflecting → reflect: 'all they had to do was __'처럼 주어가 do(하다)를 포함할 때는, be동사(was) 뒤에 to를 뺀 원형부정사가 옵니다. 그래서 reflect가 맞아요. reflecting은 틀림 ←정답
det.tip: All you have to do is + 동사원형! (do가 있으면 뒤 was 다음은 원형) → was reflect

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (1단어) (영어로)

det.korean: 동사 → 형용사. reflect → reflective

det.tip: reflect(동사) → reflective(형용사). 뒤의 명사 journaling을 꾸며요.

questions.stem: 윗글의 요지로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 가치를 중심으로 경험을 성찰하고 기록하면 삶에서 의미를 찾을 수 있다.
det.analysis:

questions.stem:
다음 우리말에 맞도록 주어진 조건에 따라 빈칸에 들어갈 말을 영작하시오. (영어로)
"(과거에) 일어난 일을 되돌아보고 그것에 관해 쓰는 것"
[조건] (1) about, and, back, on, thinking, writing을 모두 사용 (2) 정확히 6단어로 쓸 것

det.korean: 일어난 일을 되돌아보고 그것에 관해 쓰는 것
det.analysis: 원문 'reflective journaling — thinking back on and writing about what has happened to us'에서 성찰적 저널쓰기를 설명하는 동명사구를 영작합니다. 두 동작을 and로 병렬 연결해요. '되돌아보다'는 구동사 think back on → thinking back on, '~에 관해 쓰다'는 write about → writing about. 앞을 동명사로 시작했으니 뒤도 동명사로 맞춰 thinking ... and writing 형태가 됩니다.
det.tip: 되돌아보다 = think back on → thinking back on / ~에 관해 쓰다 = write about → writing about. and로 -ing끼리 연결!
